symbolic_components.additional: all staged full original/prefix/material copies, typed headers, immutable source/model captures, actual native dense covariance workspace, raw original storage, journals, external observation, host/runtime overhead and OTHER

held_model_volume: bounded local-driver tmpfs cap+1MiB, requiring nativeLinuxDocker qualification
stream_predictions: one fixedwidth response at a time; hostcapture extent derived from fullshape
outer_managed_limits: Separate explicitly selected outer_limits; total declared managed read/write ceilings are controller limits plus outer_limits, never one reused cap.
outer_retention_and_other: Root accounts both retention allowances and other active holds; each actual write/copy checks available capacity. Occupied outputs and future allowances remain distinct.
original_clocks: One observer BOOT origin; controller work_end=origin+limits.wall_seconds; outerend=origin+outer_limits.wall_seconds, at least120s later. Root independently admits outer durable return and terminal close.
managed_transport_accounting: Every actual Docker/duplex stdout and stderr read is charged before overflow admission; captured decoded chunks are additionally charged as materialized rereads. Duplex outbound request bytes are separately reported, not retained-file writes. Startup authority reads are bounded before materialization and charged to the successful original-clock budget.
grading_source_binding: Independent grading authority pins the same complete source manifest as the collection and preparation; all members, including grading dependencies, authenticate before protected targets. Exclusive operator custody remains an external prerequisite.
